requirements.title: PROCUREMENT SOURCE LAYER
requirements.notes: A manager-triggered generic HTTP(S) JSON feed contract stores canonical content hashes and append-only observed versions, scopes provider-local IDs to each source, distinguishes unchanged replays and emits one outbox event per real version; bearer authentication is HTTPS-only. Every configured attempt persists a final source-run receipt with timing, HTTP/outcome counters, a secret-safe manager view and transactional outbox event. The optional tender-page-v1 contract now persists and resumes same-origin next-page checkpoints only after successful page transactions, hashes provider acknowledgements/cursors in receipts, records partial/complete/unknown and rejects invalid or non-advancing pagination fail-closed. Official EIS/ETP adapters, legal access agreements, stable provider keys and verified portal-specific completeness contracts remain missing.

requirements.title: ЕДИНАЯ НОРМАЛИЗОВАННАЯ МОДЕЛЬ ТЕНДЕРА
requirements.notes: The shared PostgreSQL record, document and immutable assessment models provide a working normalized core with canonical feed-version provenance. Generic feed identity is enforced by source plus provider-local external ID without weakening non-tender uniqueness. A dedicated relational procurement/amendment graph and stable provider keys from official adapters remain missing.

requirements.title: DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE PIPELINE
requirements.notes: Secure download now keeps checksum-addressed byte files and append-only version metadata, reuses exact replays, rejects on-disk checksum conflicts and feeds checksum-bound local PDF/DOCX/TXT/Markdown extraction. Malware scanning, archive sandbox, OCR, tables and semantic amendment diffing remain incomplete.

requirements.title: PROMPT INJECTION DEFENSE
requirements.notes: Tender extraction treats document content as untrusted, uses no external AI or tools, and flags common injection text. A broader adversarial document corpus and all-format sandbox remain open.

requirements.title: TENDER REQUIREMENTS ENGINE

requirements.title: COMPANY DIGITAL TWIN
requirements.notes: A manager-only API now persists immutable, idempotent Company Digital Twin snapshots against an existing legal requisites profile. The canonical snapshot covers masked legal identity, tax/VAT, categories/geography, exact Decimal business limits, a fixed qualification-capability taxonomy and document issue/expiry/issuer/verification/file-hash metadata. Payment account values remain in the protected requisites table and only completeness plus a fingerprint enter the snapshot/API. Expired, unknown, unsupported, unproven or restricted facts fail closed; only an integrity-checked verified snapshot whose documents remain valid through tender deadline can bind prequalification. Directors, authorized employees, MChD/signature certificates, insurance, contract/penalty history, automated registry verification and conflict refresh remain missing, so the requirement stays PARTIAL.

requirements.title: PREQUALIFICATION ENGINE
requirements.notes: A manager-only, idempotent FAST DISQUALIFICATION entry point persists an immutable snapshot across 14 fixed hard-constraint classes. Known facts require exact tender-document checksum evidence; missing, UNKNOWN and unproven facts fail closed, while evidence-backed failures produce explainable hard stops. A prequalification may now bind an integrity-checked verified Company Digital Twin and rejects capability-status mismatch or any company document expiring before tender deadline. An eligible exact snapshot can be bound to the decision passport. Automated company evidence acquisition and real supplier discovery remain missing, so the requirement stays PARTIAL.

requirements.title: SUPPLIER DISCOVERY AGENT
requirements.notes: A manager-only manual/import entry point now persists an immutable, idempotent supplier quote snapshot after an exact eligible prequalification. The snapshot captures typed supplier/product/price/VAT/stock/delivery/payment/freshness/compliance/reliability fields with exact tender-document evidence. UNKNOWN, expired and incomplete quotes fail closed; only an integrity-checked verified quote hash matching the same prequalification and inline decision quote can feed economics. Automated supplier discovery, external quote parsing, RFQ, reservations and backups remain missing, so the requirement stays PARTIAL.

requirements.title: НЕ ПУТАТЬ «ПОХОЖИЙ ТОВАР» И «СООТВЕТСТВУЮЩИЙ ТОВАР»
requirements.notes: Decision snapshots persist an evidence-bound parameter matrix and fail closed for mandatory UNKNOWN/mismatch. Local extraction persists parameter/value candidates as UNKNOWN; an exact checksum/version/candidate-bound manager review persists verified or rejected facts. Automated cross-document matching remains missing.

requirements.title: FEATURE FLAGS
requirements.notes: Every code-owned protected Task/Orchestrator action has an explicit persisted flag. Missing or disabled flags fail closed before approval; managers have a read view and only the owner can perform reasoned, versioned, idempotent changes with audit/outbox evidence. The Decision Engine evaluates global, per-tender and capability controls in order for record-bound participation/submission; direct SMTP bulk-outreach and social-provider workers share the applicable global/capability gate and preserve queued work while stopped. Initial enabled values preserve existing approval-only workflows and never bypass owner approval, consent, suppression or rate limits. Future direct protected adapters still require enforcement at their execution boundary, so the requirement stays PARTIAL.

requirements.title: KILL SWITCH
requirements.notes: Verified 2026-09-07: persisted owner-only control blocks every protected action before approval, preserves read-only work, and records idempotent audit/outbox evidence.

requirements.title: PER-TENDER KILL SWITCH
requirements.notes: Verified 2026-09-11: each persisted tender has an isolated manager-readable, owner-only stop with required activation reason, idempotent versioning and audit/outbox evidence. Decision Engine checks global stop, exact tender stop and capability before creating or accepting participation/submission approval. Another tender is unaffected, global stop retains precedence and release never resumes old work automatically.

requirements.title: SOURCE FRESHNESS
requirements.notes: Each configured generic-feed attempt records final success/failure evidence. A configurable deterministic last-success SLO classifies fresh, unobserved, never-succeeded, latest-failed and stale sources; manager API and deduplicated System Admin incident/recovery are connected without exposing source credentials. For tender-page-v1, protected same-origin pagination checkpoints, hashed acknowledgement/cursor evidence and explicit partial/complete/unknown receipts are now persisted. Feeds without the page contract remain unknown, and official portal completeness guarantees are unverified, so SOURCE FRESHNESS stays PARTIAL.
